messages.text: At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. You're buying a live shot at a full block, sats stacking to your own wallet meanwhile, and a real piece of the network running where you can see it. What do you pay per kWh?
how many success rates in a month

About 4,300 draws a month — a block comes up roughly every ten minutes, and your H15 is in every one of them, around the clock, for years. The win odds per draw depend on your hashrate against the whole network; I don't want to quote a number I haven't run for you.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll run the real figures.
it runs both doge and btc at the same time?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin

Yes — both at once, two chips in one box. 15 TH/s on SHA‑256 for Bitcoin and 1.08 GH/s on Scrypt for Doge/Litecoin, about 500W total, ~50 dB. $999, ships November 14, 2026.

That 500W is roughly $36 a month at 10¢/kWh. What's your rate?
so if in a pool for btc and doge, how much income per month

Pooled, the H15 pays small and steady in both — BTC on the SHA side, Doge/LTC on the Scrypt side, straight to your own wallets, no exchange. At 15 TH/s that's a modest monthly stack against roughly $36–$52 of power depending on your rate.

Tell me your per‑kWh price and I'll give you the sats figure next to the bill.
how much income per month with the current market prices. I have solar power

With solar it changes the whole picture: the power is already yours, so whatever it stacks is kept, and the block shot runs free around the clock.

I won't guess today's sats figure. I've asked the team to send you the exact monthly numbers at current BTC and DOGE prices — they'll confirm by email, usually within one business day.
